title: Three Terms and One Short Letter
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（人与自我·做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（人与自我·做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：influence　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 influence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the friend ① used the influence that no student in the hall would have recorded, and he said the using was the whole of the term. The ② influence, meaning the power itself and not the letter, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a influence, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ influence in that hall had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ influence at the far desk, meaning the advice they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A influence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the friend said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the influence was the whole of the matter, meaning the choice and not the power. The ⑥ influence, meaning the choice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; influence, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a power and a choice. He said the choice is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ influence had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ influence of the whole thing, the friend wrote in March, was one hall and three terms of recording; influence, he said, is either the advice at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ influence I remember is the power recorded in the file, which closed in 2003 and is still recorded as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ influence, my mother said in 2005, is the only power that improves by being recorded; every influence, she said, is a choice that has agreed to look like a power. She said the choice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 影响；作用（指礼堂里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 影响；作用（指那种影响力本身，与书信相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the influence 施加这种影响
D. n. 影响；作用（指留给孩子们照着做的那一条那一种）
E. n. 取舍之事（抽象总称，指一处礼堂的影响之事）
F. n. 影响；作用（指档案里写到、被记下的的那一种）
G. n. 选择、取向（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 取向（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the influence that no student in the hall would have recorded
The influence, meaning the power itself and not the letter
the influence at the far desk
the influence was the whole of the matter
the influence had become a line in a file
The influence of the whole thing
A influence, my mother said in 2005

answers.why: use the influence 意为“施加这种影响”，1996 年那位朋友把礼堂里没有一位学生肯记录的一种影响做了一遍。
influence 意为“影响；作用”，指那种影响力本身而不是书信，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。
influence 意为“影响；作用”，指礼堂里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一封薄薄的书信。
influence 意为“影响；作用”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们照着做的那一条那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
influence 意为“选择、取向”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个选择就是那件事的全部。
influence 意为“取向”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种影响力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
influence 意为“影响；作用”，指档案里写到、被记下的的那一种，到 2001 年这一种成了档案里的一行。
influence 意为“取舍之事”，朋友三月写道，整件事的影响之事是一处礼堂和三个学期的记录。
influence 意为“影响；作用”，我记得的是档案里记录过的那一种，2003 年定夺了，至今仍被说成礼堂里最安静的一种。
influence 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，影响是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的影响力。
